headline: Sensex gains 400 points as Nifty crosses 25,200 driven by FII inflows and positive global cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) inflows and lower crude oil prices supported broader market sentiment.
Morgan Stanley noted India deserves a re-rating and projected the Sensex could hit 95,000 by December 2027.
Rally in IT and banking sector stocks lifted early morning trade performance.
Benchmark indices rebounded following support across key large-cap gainers like Asian Paints and Bharti Airtel.
whatHappening: Sensex gained up to 400 points while Nifty 50 crossed and held near the 25,200 level.
Natco Pharma shares rallied 7% to 9% despite weak Q2 performance.
Kaynes Technology shares dropped sharply by 10% to 15% in early trading.
Inox Wind fell 10% after announcing its Q2 financial results.
summary:
Indian stock markets opened on a strong note on 16 November, with the Sensex rising 400 points and Nifty trading above 25,200.
Positive momentum was backed by FII inflows, softer crude oil prices, and buying in IT and banking stocks.
Despite the benchmark rally, individual stock reactions were mixed as Natco Pharma jumped on results while Kaynes Technology and Inox Wind faced severe selling.
